senses.gloss:
Ugratejas,
(1) n. of a former Buddha: LV 〔5.11〕
(2) n. of a god (devaputra): LV 〔39.13〕 (prose; ˚tejo, n. sg.);
(3) n. of a son of Māra, unfavorable to the Bodhisattva: LV 〔310.9〕 ˚tejā(s), n. sg.
Ugraparipṛcchā, = prec.: Mvy 〔1396〕; Sikṣ 〔11.2〕; [] 〔120.3〕; 〔131.10〕; 〔315.14〕; called Ugraparipṛcchā-sūtra (cf. Ugrasūtra?), Śikṣ 〔136.1〕.
Ugra-lipi, a kind of writing: LV 〔125.22〕. Tib. drag śul can confirms ugra-; cf. under ukara-.

Ugra-sūtra, n. of a work: Karmav 〔162.6〕; see s.v. Ugra (2), and Léviʼs note. The passage here cited does not occur among the Śikṣ citations from the Ugraparipṛcchā(sūtra), which may or may not be a different work.
Ugrasena (= Pali Uggasena), n. of a king of Benares, in story of the nāga Campaka (Pali Campeyya Jātaka): Mv 〔ii.177.9 ff.〕
